stem: The Whiskey Rebellion challenged the idea that —

options.label: A
options.text: the federal government had the power to pass and enforce tax laws

options.label: B
options.text: a national military was needed for dealing with foreign threats

options.label: C
options.text: the federal government could raise tariffs to protect industries

options.label: D
options.text: a national court system was needed for resolving disputes between states
